turns.question: one csv is there. make a 2024 Monsoon block wise crop yield dashboard, tonnes per hectare highest first. i should see source and download the table
turns.sql: SELECT block, source, (harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(cultivated_hectares, 0)) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE year = 2024 AND season = 'Monsoon' ORDER BY tonnes_per_hectare DESC

turns.question: now show 2023 and 2024 Monsoon tonnes per hectare trend for every block
turns.sql: WITH YearlyData AS (SELECT block, year, (harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(cultivated_hectares, 0), 0)) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND year IN (2023, 2024)) SELECT y23.block, y23.tonnes_per_hectare AS tonnes_per_hectare_2023, y24.tonnes_per_hectare AS tonnes_per_hectare_2024, (y24.tonnes_per_hectare - y23.tonnes_per_hectare) AS percentage_point_change FROM YearlyData AS y23 JOIN YearlyData AS y24 ON y23.block = y24.block WHERE y23.year = 2023 AND y24.year = 2024 ORDER BY y23.block NULLS FIRST

turns.question: only Bhojpur and Wardha now, compare change in tonnes per hectare from 2023 to 2024. keep source and download
turns.sql: WITH YearlyData AS (SELECT block, source, year, (harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(cultivated_hectares, 0), 0)) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND block IN ('Bhojpur', 'Wardha') AND year IN (2023, 2024)) SELECT y23.block, y23.source, y23.tonnes_per_hectare AS tonnes_per_hectare_2023, y24.tonnes_per_hectare AS tonnes_per_hectare_2024, (y24.tonnes_per_hectare - y23.tonnes_per_hectare) AS percentage_point_change FROM YearlyData AS y23 JOIN YearlyData AS y24 ON y23.block = y24.block WHERE y23.year = 2023 AND y24.year = 2024 ORDER BY y23.block NULLS FIRST
